I will do it close to the way I know, because this maize land is mine and I do not want to leave it hungry, but I will not spend too much cash. I will put some fertilizer, not plenty, and I will also carry manure from the compound because that one helps the soil. I will keep the seed I trust, the one I have seen people around me use well, and I will not irrigate because I wait for the rains here. I will use some chemical for weeds, and because I am old now, I will bring a few laborers when work is heavy.
